cover.sub: 5 niche things that will make you
cover.title: disgustingly good at spotting bot traffic

inner.title: over half aren't human
inner.body: imperva's 2026 bad bot report says bots now make up over 53% of all web traffic. half your dashboard's visitors may never have had a pulse.
inner.label: no pulse

inner.title: zero-second sessions
inner.body: a spike on one page with near-zero read time suggests a scraper. a bounce rate that repeats exactly every day is a script, not an audience.
inner.label: humans skim

inner.title: suspiciously american
inner.body: a decodo analysis of cloudflare radar data says the us sends 53.5% of global bot traffic. a us-heavy dashboard proves nothing about us customers.
inner.label: datacenter americans

inner.title: crawlers never click
inner.body: cloudflare counted 38,065 anthropic crawls per referred visit in july 2025, and about 1,091 for openai. they read everything and send almost nobody back.
inner.label: 38,065 to 1

inner.title: bots that sign up
inner.body: sms pumping bots sign up with throwaway emails and trigger texts to numbers they control. okta says you pay, potentially hundreds of thousands of dollars.
inner.label: you pay

closer.HEADLINE:
